q1_issues.issue: "QVC management team" is a proper noun premodifying a common-noun head, which the instruction set links with the opaque `Possession` unless a more specific relation is stated; `(PartOf sk_team_1 qvc)` invents the part-whole relation the rule explicitly bars.

"the remaining shares" has a dedicated remainder encoding (the portion plus `(RestOf <rest> <whole>)` and `SubsetOf`/`PartOf` to the definite whole), but the parse drops the remainder relation and records it as an ad-hoc property atom on the group symbol instead.

notes: `Holder` for "hold the shares" is defensible as a possession state, though the instruction set's own stative-transitive example ("the tank holds forty litres") takes `Agent`. No per-member distribution rule was emitted for the holding; the collective reading is defensible.
